description: Sun Shangxiang, lively young chinese woman warrior in the supplied pixel art style. Brown hair in a high ponytail tied with a red ribbon, a red and tan outfit with gold trim and a white skirt panel, a quiver of arrows on her back, brown boots. She holds a brown recurve bow in the left hand
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the brown ponytail with the red ribbon, the red outfit, the quiver across the back, the bow at her left side.
guard_action: the left hand raises the bow in front of the body, the right hand comes to the string, the feet take an archer stance

actions.idle: Archer ready stance, bow held in front in the left hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place carrying the bow in the left hand, no shooting. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One arrow shot. Frames 1-6 the bow is raised level and the right hand draws the string back to full draw; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 the bow arm stays out. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: High shot. Frames 1-6 the bow is lifted high, level with the head, and drawn, aiming from above downward; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Deep-drawn shot. Frames 1-7 a slow very deep draw, leaning back; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 a long follow-through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s5: Graceful stunning shot. Frames 1-7 a light step back and a high elegant draw; frame 9 release; frames 10-12 hold the pose. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The bow stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: Side-on shot. Frames 1-6 he turns the body fully side-on to the target and draws; frame 9 release; frames 10-11 hold side-on.
actions.b2: Two quick shots. Frames 1-5 a fast draw; frame 6 release; frames 7-9 a second fast draw; frame 10 release; frame 11 follow through.
actions.c4: Triple shot. Frames 1-4 draw; frame 5 release; frames 6-7 redraw; frame 8 release; frames 9-11 a third draw and release, the bow swinging slightly to a new target each time.
actions.c6: Leaping shot. He crouches, jumps, draws the bow in the air and releases at the top of the jump; he lands and settles.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s5. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
